meta.title: "How far from best" on the vendor card is computed on the vendor's own total
gaps: The available read-back fields do not expose the vendor-card “difference from best” percentage, so the expected 5.0% calculation and the zero-difference hidden state when the vendor is best cannot be checked.
The available setup starts with an RFQ rather than a price auction; the plan converts it to an auction, but the auction-specific card field is not available for assertion.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer invites QA vendor 2 to the live pricing round for a second QA vendor.
The buyer converts the pricing round into a live auction.
The invited QA vendor places a complete bid of 1000 (open, price, submit).
A second QA vendor places a complete bid of 950 (open, price, submit).
The buyer reads the round's comparison (ranks, best bidder).
